offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage; Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens. Token 价格: Prototype Development $50 / 0.050 per 1M tokens; Production Deployment $500 / 0.045 per 1M tokens
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens (Toy Experiment, 10 Million tokens, Non-commercial use only CC-BY-NC)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果: 返回前五条搜索结果的 URL 与内容 (LLM-friendly text, JSON)
offerings.note: Search mode 返回 5 条结果; rate limit 100 RPM (free), 1000 RPM (premium); 平均延迟 2.5s。
